body: PRE-PROPOSAL STATE CONTRADICTION on ca9bcfa, derived from the handoff text only; no reserved source inspected. The chief's sole f3fa blocker explicitly says do not replace this with another wrapper or a data-only/package-scoped factory and prefers removing/defering public human/fixture issuance until an actual governed verifier exists. The ca9 handoff instead says it adds ViewEvidenceAdmitter with trusted registration private[storymodel4s] and admission private[acquire]. External compile refusal proves only that outside packages cannot call those doors; it does not establish who inside those broad package scopes is entitled to issue the status, and therefore appears to implement the expressly rejected remedy shape. Pause before proposal/re-gate and obtain chief confirmation that ca9 contains an actual independently governed issuer rather than a package-scoped mint. If it does not, preserve the framing work and use the chief's removal/deferment path. This is a contract/state finding, not a code verdict.
